profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer with a passion for learning and a gift for problem solving.
profile.summary:
I recently accepted a position with JP Morgan Chase in their ETSE program after being laid off as an SDE1 apprentice at Amazon in Seattle. In 2022 I completed a program with Kenzie Academy in collaboration with Amazon. The program was Java centric and also covered much of Amazon Web Services. I also completed the Web Developer Coding Bootcamp through the U of MN where I gained a working knowledge of various technologies such as React, JavaScript, SQL, HTML, CSS, and more.
 
I am armed with technical skills and knowledge and have an arsenal of experience and soft skills that I’ve gained and honed in my pre-developer career.  
 
Having worked in the Medical and Donor Industries, I am accustomed to working within strict time constraints, adhering to set Federal guidelines (FDA, HIPAA, etc.), juggling multiple priorities, and ensuring a high standard of quality. I enjoy taking a customer need and helping to evolve it from a concept into a solution.

projects.title: Clicky Game
projects.description:
Clicky game is fun memory game. The user selects an image and all images change position after every click. The goal is to click on each different image without clicking on any image more than once. The game keeps track of the score for each game and the top score for each session.

Technology used: React, HTML, CSS, jQuery

projects.title: Gem Collector
projects.description:
The Gem Collector application focuses on memory and addition skills. The user works to build their score to match the Target Score. Features click handlers, score calculation, and random value generation. I was the sole developer of this project. 

Technology used: HTML, CSS, jQuery, Bootstrap
